display.purpose: Page title bars, dialog headlines, entity names (character cards, combatants) and hero numerals — the single illuminated value of a surface. Weight rises to bold/black on numerals.

headline.purpose: Section headers inside a screen, modal titles.

body.purpose: Rule text, descriptions, narrative copy. Cap line length at 65–75ch.

label.purpose: Form labels, chips, tags, legend captions.

mono.purpose: Dice values, AC, HP numbers, history timestamps. Tabular-nums.

shadows.name: shadow-engrave
shadows.purpose: Stamped-metal inset on gold primary buttons.

motion.name: spring-elastic
motion.purpose: Dice roller and single-element value pops only (a result number landing). Never layout, lists, pages, or modals.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Primary affordance — gold leaf with engrave inset. Reserved for the single most important action on a screen.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 8px; min-height: 48px; padding: 12px 16px; border: none; border-radius: 12px; background: linear-gradient(170deg, #f0c970 0%, #d4a847 50%, #5a4820 100%); color: #0d0a08; font-family: Cinzel, Georgia, serif; font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: 0.04em; text-transform: uppercase; cursor: pointer; box-shadow: inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255,220,140,0.25), inset 0 -1px 2px rgba(0,0,0,0.35); transition: filter 160ms cubic-bezier(0.22,1,0.36,1), transform 160ms cubic-bezier(0.22,1,0.36,1); } .ds-btn-primary:hover { filter: brightness(1.06); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255,220,140,0.25), inset 0 -1px 2px rgba(0,0,0,0.35), 0 0 0 2px rgba(212,168,71,0.35), 0 0 18px rgba(240,201,112,0.22); } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: scale(0.97); }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: Raised parchment surface with a gold-dim hairline that warms to gold on hover.
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 8px; min-height: 48px; padding: 12px 16px; border-radius: 12px; background: #2f261f; color: #ebdfbf; font-family: Cinzel, Georgia, serif; font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: 0.04em; text-transform: uppercase; border: 1px solid rgba(139,115,53,0.3); cursor: pointer; transition: border-color 160ms cubic-bezier(0.22,1,0.36,1), transform 160ms cubic-bezier(0.22,1,0.36,1); } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { border-color: rgba(212,168,71,0.7); } .ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px rgba(212,168,71,0.35), 0 0 18px rgba(240,201,112,0.22); } .ds-btn-secondary:active { transform: scale(0.97); }

components.name: Danger Button
components.description: Crimson-tinted warning for destructive actions. Never solid red.
components.css: .ds-btn-danger { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 8px; min-height: 48px; padding: 12px 16px; border-radius: 12px; background: rgba(179,58,58,0.15); color: #e85050; border: 1px solid rgba(179,58,58,0.4); font-family: Cinzel, Georgia, serif; font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: 0.04em; text-transform: uppercase; cursor: pointer; transition: background 160ms cubic-bezier(0.22,1,0.36,1), border-color 160ms cubic-bezier(0.22,1,0.36,1), transform 160ms cubic-bezier(0.22,1,0.36,1); } .ds-btn-danger:hover { background: rgba(179,58,58,0.25); border-color: rgba(179,58,58,0.6); } .ds-btn-danger:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px rgba(179,58,58,0.35), 0 0 14px rgba(179,58,58,0.25); } .ds-btn-danger:active { transform: scale(0.97); }

components.name: Arcane Button
components.description: Magic affordance — arcane gradient with halo glow. For cast / concentrate actions.
components.css: .ds-btn-arcane { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 8px; min-height: 48px; padding: 12px 16px; border-radius: 12px; background: linear-gradient(90deg, #4a2858 0%, #9b59b6 100%); color: #f4e8c1; border: 1px solid rgba(197,137,232,0.4); font-family: Cinzel, Georgia, serif; font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: 0.04em; text-transform: uppercase; cursor: pointer; box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px rgba(155,89,182,0.35), 0 0 22px rgba(155,89,182,0.25); transition: filter 160ms cubic-bezier(0.22,1,0.36,1), transform 160ms cubic-bezier(0.22,1,0.36,1); } .ds-btn-arcane:hover { filter: brightness(1.08); } .ds-btn-arcane:active { transform: scale(0.97); }

components.name: Text Input
components.description: Quill-line input — single underline that warms to gold under focus.
components.css: .ds-input-wrap { display: block; } .ds-input-label { display: block; margin-bottom: 6px; font-family: Cinzel, Georgia, serif; font-size: 0.6875rem; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: 0.08em; text-transform: uppercase; color: #8b7335; transition: color 160ms cubic-bezier(0.22,1,0.36,1); } .ds-input-wrap:focus-within .ds-input-label { color: #f0c970; } .ds-input { width: 100%; min-height: 48px; padding: 10px 12px; background: #241d18; color: #ebdfbf; font-family: Fraunces, Georgia, serif; font-size: 0.9375rem; font-feature-settings: "ss01", "ss02"; border: none; border-bottom: 2px solid #4a3d30; border-radius: 8px 8px 0 0; outline: none; transition: border-color 200ms cubic-bezier(0.22,1,0.36,1), box-shadow 200ms cubic-bezier(0.22,1,0.36,1); } .ds-input::placeholder { color: #857761; } .ds-input:focus { border-bottom-color: #d4a847; box-shadow: 0 2px 0 0 rgba(240,201,112,0.22); }

components.name: Tome Card
components.description: Hero container — parchment gradient + grain + ornamented border.
components.html:
Mago — Livello 7

Hai vinto contro un drago verde nel feudo del Re Cervo. Riposo lungo applicato.
components.css: .ds-card-tome { position: relative; padding: 16px; border-radius: 16px; background: linear-gradient(160deg, #2f261f 0%, #241d18 60%, #2f261f 100%); border: 1px solid #6b5841; box-shadow: 0 14px 28px rgba(26,16,8,0.40), 0 6px 10px rgba(26,16,8,0.25); color: #ebdfbf; isolation: isolate; } .ds-card-tome::before { content: ''; position: absolute; inset: 0; border-radius: inherit; background-image: url("data:image/svg+xml;utf8,<svg xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg' width='140' height='140'><filter id='n'><feTurbulence type='fractalNoise' baseFrequency='0.85' numOctaves='2' stitchTiles='stitch' seed='5'/><feColorMatrix values='0 0 0 0 0.08 0 0 0 0 0.06 0 0 0 0 0.04 0 0 0 0.9 0'/></filter><rect width='100%' height='100%' filter='url(%23n)'/></svg>"); opacity: 0.06; mix-blend-mode: overlay; pointer-events: none; z-index: 0; } .ds-card-tome > * { position: relative; z-index: 1; } .ds-card-title { margin: 0 0 8px; font-family: Cinzel, Georgia, serif; font-size: 1.25rem; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: 0.02em; color: #f0c970; } .ds-card-body { margin: 0; font-family: Fraunces, Georgia, serif; font-size: 0.9375rem; line-height: 1.55; font-feature-settings: "ss01", "ss02"; color: #ebdfbf; }

components.name: Inscribed Chip
components.description: Small inscribed label — Cinzel caps on gold-tinted ground with hairline. Static, never interactive, never haloed.
components.css: .ds-chip { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; padding: 4px 10px; border-radius: 8px; background: rgba(240,201,112,0.08); border: 1px solid rgba(240,201,112,0.18); color: #f0c970; font-family: Cinzel, Georgia, serif; font-size: 0.6875rem; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: 0.08em; text-transform: uppercase; }

components.name: Filter Pill
components.description: Interactive filter toggle — full-round pill, 44px touch target. Selected state carries tint, strong border and a gold selection halo (a selection ring, not an attention halo). The pill shape is the interactivity signal: static chips stay lozenge.
components.css: .ds-pill { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; min-height: 44px; padding: 6px 12px; border-radius: 999px; background: #241d18; border: 1px solid #4a3d30; color: #b5a482; font-family: Cinzel, Georgia, serif; font-size: 0.6875rem; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: 0.08em; text-transform: uppercase; cursor: pointer; transition: color 160ms cubic-bezier(0.22,1,0.36,1), border-color 160ms cubic-bezier(0.22,1,0.36,1); } .ds-pill:hover { color: rgba(240,201,112,0.8); } .ds-pill:active { transform: scale(0.95); } .ds-pill-selected { background: rgba(240,201,112,0.08); border-color: rgba(212,168,71,0.7); color: #f0c970; box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px rgba(212,168,71,0.35), 0 0 18px rgba(240,201,112,0.22); } .ds-pill-count { padding: 0 6px; border-radius: 999px; background: rgba(36,29,24,0.6); font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', ui-monospace, monospace; font-size: 0.625rem; font-weight: 500; }

components.name: HP Hero Number
components.description: Signature numeric — the hero value as an illuminated capital (Cormorant Unicase, black weight) with threshold-mapped glow; the /max companion stays JetBrains Mono.
components.html:
HP
38/54

components.description: Signature panel — parchment gradient with accent border and corner flourishes.
components.html:
Tiro Critico

d20 = 20. Il colpo trafigge l'armatura nemica.

narrative.overview:
The interface borrows from a leather-bound book of hours read by candlelight. Surfaces are warm-brown ink and aged parchment; ornament is gold leaf, applied sparingly so it still catches light. The default mode is dark, the way a real codex looks under a single lamp at the table; the light mode is aged parchment, the way the same codex looks held to a window the next morning. Both are equally first-class.

Density is moderate. There is real ornament — corner flourishes, ornament rules, candle-glow halos — but it is concentrated where the eye lands first (page headers, dialog frames, the rare hero element) and absent everywhere else. Reading surfaces (rule text, item descriptions, dice tallies) defer to plain hierarchy so a player at the table can find their AC in 1.5 seconds. The system is epica, leggibile, calma, tattile — epic, legible, calm, tactile — in that order of priority. When two of those collide, legibility wins; tactility loses.

The system explicitly rejects the SaaS-cream reflex, the D&D Beyond neon-on-black register, the Roll20 WordPress-2014 chrome, the gacha mobile particles register, and the AI-slop tinted-card-grid default.
keyCharacteristics: Warm-brown ink (#1a1512) and aged parchment (#f4e8c1) — never pure black, never pure white.
Gold ink (#d4a847 → #f0c970) reserved for primary affordance and ornament. <10% surface coverage.
Fantasy-serif type stack: Cormorant Unicase for display, Cinzel for labels and titles, Fraunces for body, JetBrains Mono for numerics.
Halo glows (gold / arcane / danger) signal required action, not decoration.
Subtle SVG turbulence grain (0.035 dark / 0.09 light) — printed-page texture.
Five named semantic palettes: gold (primary), crimson (danger), emerald (success), arcane (magic), cobalt (info), amber (highlight).

Motion uses ease-out parchment curves. One elastic spring (stiffness 240 / damping 10) is reserved for the dice roller and single-element value pops; elastic never moves layout, lists, pages, or modals.

rules.name: The Gold Leaf Rule
rules.body: Gold is the primary affordance and the focus halo. It must not exceed 10% of any rendered screen and must not appear as a decorative gradient on text. If you need to draw the eye somewhere and gold is already used elsewhere on the screen, you have placed the wrong element first — rebuild the hierarchy, do not double-up gold.

rules.name: The Two Inks Rule
rules.body: Surfaces use the warm-brown ink family; ornament uses gold ink. Mixing the two on the same element flattens the manuscript metaphor. Keep them separate.

rules.name: The Semantic Triad Rule
rules.body: Crimson / Emerald / Arcane are reserved for their semantic meanings (damage, healing, magic). Never use them decoratively. If a surface needs visual interest, use surface elevation or ornament — not borrowed semantic color.

rules.name: The Inscription Rule
rules.body: Cinzel is for inscribed words: section headers, labels, chips, button text, ornamental rules. Use it short — never set a paragraph in Cinzel; never set a label in Fraunces. Long-form text always falls to Fraunces.

rules.name: The Illuminated Capital Rule
rules.body: Cormorant Unicase speaks only for what the manuscript would illuminate: proper names (the character, a combatant, a page title) and the one hero value the eye must land on first (current HP, AC, a coin total). Everything structural stays in Cinzel. If a screen sets more than one or two values in Cormorant, it has stopped illuminating and started shouting.

rules.name: The Tabular Numerics Rule
rules.body: Any number that compares against another number is set in JetBrains Mono with font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums. Mixed-font numerics inside a row break the rhythm. One sanctioned exception: the single hero numeral of a surface is an illuminated capital in Cormorant Unicase; its comparative companions stay mono — 38 may be illuminated, /54 never is.

rules.name: The No Gradient Text Rule
rules.body: Gradient text is reserved for one ornamental flourish element per page. Body text, headings, button labels, numerics — all solid color.

rules.name: The Warm-Shadow Rule
rules.body: Shadows are tinted warm-brown, never neutral gray, never pure black. A neutral-gray drop shadow on parchment looks like a screenshot of a dialog box, not a page lifting off a tome.

rules.name: The Halo-as-Signal Rule
rules.body: Halos carry meaning, never decoration, never hover-only fluff. Two dialects: attention ('act here now') allows at most one per screen; selection (the ring on a selected filter pill) marks 'this is shaping what you see' and may repeat across a filter row. A halo that is neither attention nor selection is forbidden.

dos: Do ground every neutral in the warm-brown family; tint gray toward #1a1512 or #f4e8c1.
Do reserve gold (#d4a847 / #f0c970) for primary affordance and ornament — under 10% of any screen.
Do pair color with icon and label on every semantic state. A color-blind user must read the same signal at a glance.
Do use attention halos only when the user must act now; selection halos only on selected filter pills. Never decorative.
Do set inscribed elements in Cinzel; reading copy in Fraunces; comparative numerics in JetBrains Mono with tabular-nums; the single hero numeral in Cormorant Unicase.
Do ease motion with cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1). Springs for press feedback, dialog/swipe entrances, state snaps, page drift, and value pops (elastic, value reveals only).
Do respect prefers-reduced-motion: collapse animations to instant; signal lives in color + icon + copy.
Do keep tap targets at minimum 40px, 44px for destructive or hard-to-undo actions.
Do treat the light aged-parchment mode with the same rigor as dark mode.
donts: Don't ship the SaaS-cream cliché: tinted-neutral cards on tinted-neutral background, blue accent, rounded-2xl everywhere, sans-serif geometric.
Don't ship the D&D Beyond neon-on-black register: flat saturated red on pure #000, thin sans body, dashboard chrome fighting the theme.
Don't ship the Roll20 / WordPress-2014 chrome: gradient buttons, table-row layouts, untreated dropdowns, no hierarchy.
Don't ship the gacha mobile register: oversized icons, particles on every tap, ranked-up celebrations, fake gold coins, FOMO banners.
Don't ship the AI-slop default: tinted-neutral hero card with a big number, gradient-text headings, identical card grids, glassmorphism filling space.
Don't use border-left or border-right greater than 1px as a colored accent. Side-stripe borders are banned.
Don't use background-clip: text on body, headings, or button labels. The one exception is the page-header flourish glyph.
Don't apply glassmorphism decoratively. The only sanctioned use is the dialog backdrop overlay.
Don't use bouncing or elastic easing on layout, lists, pages, or modals. Elastic lives in exactly two places: the dice roller and the single-element pop of a hero number or result value.
Don't flash the screen, shake the viewport, or full-bleed-overlay red on damage.
Don't stack two named halos on the same screen.
Don't use #000 or #fff anywhere — for any reason.
Don't repeat decorative ornament inside content lists.
Don't use em dashes in UI copy.
